Observation: Initial reg.exe save attempt from non-elevated PowerShell failed with 'A required privilege is not held by the client' and exit code 1.
Resolution: Two investigator-created zero-byte destination placeholders were verified as 0 bytes, removed, and acquisition was repeated from an elevated PowerShell session.
Limitation: Registry evidence consists of Registry-aware snapshots from loaded HKU namespaces; the snapshots are not claimed to be bit-for-bit copies of the underlying live NTUSER.DAT or UsrClass.dat files.
